text: dsh-wallpaper-bg 是面向 DSH 网页界面和桌面端的壁纸背景插件。它通过浏览器客户端模块和宿主同源路由，在聊天界面后方显示壁纸。用户可选择随包内置壁纸、上传到浏览器本地库的图片或视频，或读取 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库；还可设置自定义与壁纸库循环队列、切换淡入淡出、浅色雾层和深色遮罩、模糊、亮度、安全放大及蓝粉或经典主题。网页壁纸以 iframe 显示，视频以 video 元素播放，场景显示工坊预览图。适合希望个性化 DSH 背景的用户；基础来源无需密钥，使用 Wallpaper Engine 来源时需另装配套 API 插件。

dsh-wallpaper-bg adds wallpaper backgrounds to DSH. Choose bundled art, local image/video uploads, or an optional Wallpaper Engine library; create looping queues and tune overlays, blur, brightness, zoom, and palette. Web items render in an iframe; scenes show their Workshop preview.
我想给 DSH 聊天界面换一张自己的背景图。
有没有办法把本地视频当作聊天背景循环播放？
让 DSH 的背景跟着 Wallpaper Engine 当前壁纸变化。
DSH 背景太亮或太乱时，能调暗、加雾或模糊吗？
想让上传的几张背景图按顺序自动轮播。
能不能在 DSH 网页里预览 Wallpaper Engine 的网页壁纸？
我想让界面主题颜色和壁纸搭配，也能一键切回经典配色。
如何让 DSH 页面背景显示本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库里的视频？
Can I use my own image or video as a DSH chat background?
I want DSH to follow the wallpaper currently shown by Wallpaper Engine.
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「自定义图片与视频」：在壁纸设置面板选择可解码的图片或视频文件，插件将内容存入浏览器 IndexedDB，刷新后仍可使用。
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「循环播放队列」：把自定义或 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸加入各自队列，支持排序、跳播和 1–10 分钟停留时长。
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「调节背景观感」：壁纸面板提供浅色雾层、深色遮罩、模糊、亮度和安全放大滑杆，数值会保存为设置。
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「同步桌面壁纸」：开启后定时读取 Wallpaper Engine 当前壁纸，按图片、视频、网页或场景类型显示，并可刷新或选显示器。
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「Wallpaper Engine 库浏览」：可在壁纸面板刷新本机壁纸列表，按类型和内容分级筛选，再选择要显示的壁纸。
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「网页壁纸显示」：选择网页类型的 Wallpaper Engine 项目后，客户端通过 iframe 加载服务提供的项目入口页面。
dsh-wallpaper-bg 的功能「切换背景配色」：通用外观设置可在蓝粉和经典主题间选择，壁纸面板还可单独调整背景的雾层、亮度与模糊。
使用 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库或桌面同步，需另装配套 API 插件，并具备 Windows 和本地 Wallpaper Engine。

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · dsh-wallpaper-bg：A static two-half plugin that puts an **independent animated wallpaper layer** under the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) interface — both the browser UI (`dsh web`) and the 0.2 **desktop app** (0.2.1 verified). Install it with one command (or just the package name in the desktop app's plugin page) and the whole interface sits on a moving wallpaper. The background layer is fully independent from the desktop Wallpaper Engine: changing wallpapers inside DSH never touches your desktop wallpaper, and vice versa.

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Features：- **Three wallpaper sources**: 10 built-in high-res Unsplash images (grid thumbnails and 1920w backgrounds ship with the package, so they work offline); custom uploads (images / videos, stored in IndexedDB); and read-only access to your locally installed **Wallpaper Engine** library (the companion [`dsh-wallpaper-engine-api`](https://github.com/nishuoyang/dsh-wallpaper-bg/tree/main/dsh-wallpaper-engine-api#readme) plugin serves the API and the main plugin discovers its port), filtered by the real Steam subscription list.
- **Playback queue** per source: drag wallpapers into the queue and loop-play them at 1–10 minutes per item, with drag-to-reorder, click-to-jump and localStorage persistence. The queue is sticky at the top of its tab.
- **Four render modes**: static images (cover-fit), videos (`<video object-fit: cover>`, GPU compositing), scene wallpapers (WE's own workshop preview `preview.gif` / `preview.jpg`), and web wallpapers (native iframe rendering of `index.html`).
- **Four adjustments**: light fog / dark overlay (auto-switching with the DSH theme), background blur (0–20px), background brightness (50–150%), safe zoom (0–10% to crop edge
dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Features：Full option-by-option reference: [Configuration](docs/configuration.md).

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Desktop app (no command line)：1. Open **Settings → Plugins** (设置 → 插件) and type `dsh-wallpaper-bg` into the install box;
2. Confirm, and restart the app (or reload the window) when it asks;
3. Open **Settings → Wallpaper** (设置 → 壁纸) and pick a wallpaper.

With the app's optional `dsh` command on PATH, the equivalent is:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-wallpaper-bg
```

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · CLI / browser (`dsh web`)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wallpaper-bg
```

From a checkout, link the repo instead: `dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute-path-to-repo>` (or `--profile desktop`).

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Optional: WE library source (one command)：To use the **WE 壁纸库** tab, install the companion plugin too (Windows + a local Wallpaper Engine install):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wallpaper-engine-api      # dsh web
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-wallpaper-engine-api  # desktop app (or type the package name in Settings → Plugins)
```

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Optional: WE library source (one command)：It serves a read-only WE API on `127.0.0.1:8088` and follows the DSH lifecycle; the main plugin discovers the actual port through a same-origin status route. No repository clone, `npm install`, `.bat` launcher, or login autostart. The old `wallpaper-engine-api/` folder stays for manual installs; new users just install the plugin.

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Upgrading：`dsh plugin … add` forwards to `pnpm add`, which keeps the range already recorded in the manifest — re-running the install command on an existing install changes nothing. Ask for a version explicitly:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wallpaper-bg@latest    # move to the newest release
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wallpaper-bg@0.5.18     # or pin an exact version
```

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Upgrading：> pnpm 11 installs a release only after it is a day old (24 h `minimumReleaseAge`), so a just-published version resolves to the previous one for roughly a day. Name the exact version to take it immediately.

dsh-wallpaper-bg README · Documentation：How it works, in one line: a DSH **static two-half plugin** — `lib/host.js` registers same-origin routes (`/dsh-wallpaper-bg/asset`, `/dsh-wallpaper-bg/we`, `/dsh-wallpaper-bg/health`, and auto-discovers the `dsh-wallpaper-engine-api` plugin's actual port), `lib/client.js` is a hand-written single-file browser bundle that injects the background layer and the 壁纸 settings tab, and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row into the profile composition's host plane. Detail: [Architecture](docs/architecture.md).
